title: DeepSeek banned from U.S. federal civilian agencies under new DHS order
hook_before: The Department of Homeland Security just banned DeepSeek from all federal civilian agency IT systems.
script:
This Chinese AI model was just banned by the DHS.
Officials ordered the total removal of the Chinese AI model over national security risks.
Federal workers must wipe the software from every government-issued phone and laptop immediately.
Washington authorities cited severe data collection concerns tied to foreign intelligence laws.
Contractors handling federal projects face the exact same restrictions starting this week.
Would your company ever ban a popular AI model?
